pair.title: Pair this browser
pair.subtitle: Connect this browser to your Minecraft account. No password needed.
pair.step2: Enter the key shown in chat. It expires after a few minutes and works once.
pair.invalid: That key is invalid, expired, or already used. Run /mecc pair again for a new one.
pair.footnote: This browser stays signed in until you revoke it in Settings or with /mecc revoke.

overview.subtitle: What is happening in your ME network right now

reason.NOT_DISCOVERED_YET: ME Control Center is still scanning loaded networks.
reason.NOT_LOADED: None of its Wireless Access Points is loaded. Its chunks may be unloaded, or the access points were removed.
reason.BOOTING: The network is booting and assigning channels.
reason.CONTROLLER_CONFLICT: The network has conflicting ME controllers.
reason.SPLIT: This network's access points are now in separate ME networks. Live access is paused until they are connected again.
reason.MERGED: This network is now connected to another ME Control Center network. Live access is paused until they are separated again, so neither network's members gain access to the other.
